checkedFacts: The NIST download page links SmartManufacturing_MetaData.xlsx as situational metadata about instrumentation settings and antenna position.
The NIST project page links the metadata and requests the dataset DOI when data is used for research or publication.
The U.S. government Data.gov catalog lists the related NIST dataset as public, includes XLSX among distribution formats, and points its license field to NIST's open/license policy.
NIST's policy permits attributed reuse of qualifying non-SRD NIST-created data, while describing separate treatment for Standard Reference Data and externally created material.
boundedDecision: The source-use evidence supports using short, attributed factual answers from the Ray Tracing Results numeric cells in a private independent-evaluation candidate. Cite NIST and DOI 10.18434/T44S3N. Do not reproduce workbook photographs, diagrams or chart as a deliverable under this decision. This is a source-use screen, not a final copyright determination for every embedded object.
independence: Source-use evidence does not establish question independence. Full development-exposure and cross-family semantic audit remain open; no Gold is frozen.
